summary: Iteration 4 (multi-user workspace/team sharing) tested end-to-end. Created two synthetic users (Alice + Bob) via mongosh sessions and exercised the full invite/switch/rename/remove/data-sharing flow via backend API (17 pytest cases, 100% pass) and via Playwright UI (Team page, invite dialog, WorkspaceSwitcher, sidebar nav).

issues: React a11y warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (non-blocking)

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to invite dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.

(Known/acceptable per PRD) Backend does not yet enforce viewer read-only at endpoint level — currently guarded only in UI. Consider adding require_write(user) to POST/PUT/DELETE data endpoints in a future iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1350 lines — consider splitting into routers/ modules (auth, workspaces, checks, notes, expenses, incomes, dashboard, pdf, notifications) for maintainability.

_accept_pending_invites is invoked inside /api/auth/session — verified by code review; cannot be exercised via HTTP because it requires a real Emergent OAuth session_id. Pending invite creation and DB state are covered by pytest.
list_workspaces relies on user.workspace_id (active) to compute is_active — correct.
data_owner_id resolution in _resolve_workspace_context correctly falls back to personal workspace when active_workspace_id points to a workspace the user is no longer a member of.
test_credentials: Created ephemeral test users via mongosh (see test file _mk_user fixture). Cleaned up after run. /app/memory/test_credentials.md remains empty — this app uses Emergent Google OAuth, so real credentials are not stored.
seed_data_creation: Alice + Bob users + sessions created and cleaned via pytest fixtures / mongosh.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend workspace endpoints (GET /workspaces, POST /workspaces/switch, POST /workspaces/{id}/invite, GET/DELETE /workspaces/{id}/members, PUT /workspaces/{id}/rename) plus GET /auth/me returning workspace_id/workspace_name/role all working. data_owner_id sharing verified with real cross-user check listing. UI: /team page + WorkspaceSwitcher + nav-team all rendered and functional under Alice-owner cookie session. Emergent OAuth /auth/session auto-accept path is exercised implicitly through _accept_pending_invites helper (unit-verified in code review; pending invite row correctness verified in DB).
